    assert count_nums([]) == 0

    assert count_nums([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) == 5

    assert count_nums([0]) == 0
    assert count_nums([0, 0, 0]) == 0

    # Single negative digit -> negative digit sum
    assert count_nums([-1]) == 0
    assert count_nums([-1, -2, -3]) == 0

    # Negative numbers whose first digit is outweighed -> positive sum
    assert count_nums([-12]) == 1              # -1 + 2 = 1
    assert count_nums([-123, 456, -789]) == 3  # 4, 15, 10

    # Negative numbers with zero or negative digit sums
    assert count_nums([-11]) == 0              # -1 + 1 = 0

    assert count_nums([-21, -31]) == 0         # -1, -2

    # Mixed values
    assert count_nums([1, -2, 3, -4, 5]) == 3
    assert count_nums([-1, 11, -11]) == 2      # -1, 2, 0

    # Large numbers
    assert count_nums([99999, -99999]) == 2    # 45, 27

    print("All tests passed!")
